_comment: Copy to scanner/config.json (or point SCANNER_CONFIG at a file) and fill in real addresses. Every cycle is a closed 2-leg route: leg N's output token must equal leg N+1's input token, and the cycle must start and end in borrowAsset.
_flashLoanProvider: Which engine `engineAddress` points at: 'aave' (default) reads the pool's FLASHLOAN_PREMIUM_TOTAL (fallback 5 bps); 'balancer' prices the premium at flashLoanFeeBps — Balancer V2's fee is governance-set and has always been 0, and the engine enforces the callback's real feeAmounts on-chain either way, so a wrong off-chain guess can only revert a trade, never lose money. Unknown values fail loudly.
_flashLoanFeeBps: Only used when flashLoanProvider is 'balancer': off-chain premium estimate in bps. Keep 0 unless Balancer governance sets a non-zero flash-loan fee (check docs.balancer.fi protocol fees).
_gasAccounting: Set wrappedNativeAsset (e.g. WETH) so gas cost, quoted in wei, is netted out of the profit decision. Leave zero address to ignore gas off-chain (the engine's on-chain minProfit guard still applies). On Arbitrum use WETH 0x82aF49447D8a07e3bd95BD0d56f35241523fBab1: estimateGas there already includes the L1 data fee (converted to L2 gas by the node), so gasUnits*gasPrice is the full cost.
_gasPriceFloor: F1 fix: the gate prices gas at max(getFeeData(), floor). Set the floor to >= the gasPrice your sender actually pays so the decision can never underprice gas and approve a net-negative trade. Env GAS_PRICE_FLOOR_WEI overrides. Arbitrum: min 0.02 gwei (20000000 wei) — 50000000 (0.05 gwei) is a sensible live floor; the L1 data fee is already inside eth_estimateGas on Arbitrum nodes. Sepolia: 2000000000 (2 gwei).
_netProfitOnChain: When the borrowed asset wraps native ETH, the minProfit passed on-chain includes the gas budget: a trade that cannot cover its own gas reverts (Unprofitable) instead of landing net-negative. Set false to enforce only the gross floor on-chain.
_submitRpc: Optional private/mempool-hiding RPC used ONLY for sending (with PRIVATE_KEY in .env; quotes still come from the main RPC). Ethereum L1 only: Flashbots Protect (Sepolia https://rpc-sepolia.flashbots.net/ , mainnet https://rpc.flashbots.net/fast) accepts eth_sendRawTransaction, hides the tx from the public mempool, and does NOT include reverting transactions by default, so a failed trade costs no gas. Flashbots does NOT support Arbitrum (chainId 42161): on Arbitrum the sequencer mempool is already private and MEV protection is a provider feature (Alchemy/QuickNode Arbitrum endpoints with MEV protection on). Env SUBMIT_RPC_URL overrides.

tenderly._comment: Optional fail-closed preflight: every send is dry-run against Tenderly's simulate API first; a revert there blocks the broadcast (no gas paid). strict=true also blocks on API/infra errors; set false to only block on definitive reverts. Prefer env TENDERLY_ACCESS_TOKEN / TENDERLY_ACCOUNT_SLUG / TENDERLY_PROJECT_SLUG. Requires a Tenderly paid plan.

alerts._comment: POST JSON to a Slack/Discord/Telegram bridge on profitable cycles. Prefer ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL in .env (secret). onDryRun=true also alerts when not sending.

ledger._comment: scanner/ledger.js settings: block range for event scanning (LEDGER_FROM_BLOCK/LEDGER_TO_BLOCK override), eth_getLogs chunking, and per-token decimals (default 18).

opportunities._legs: 2 legs; each leg = router address + hop path
